title: Metric register row
description: A defined measurement attached to a node, a journey, or (for business outcomes spanning journeys) a lifecycle or domain (ontology: Metric, prefix MET). evidence_status qualifies the measure's validity; causal claims between metrics live in the metric-edge register. One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: metric_id and journey_or_node_id (identity and attachment), layer, name and definition (a metric without a definition is a label), direction (without it a change cannot be read as better or worse), evidence_status (the measure's validity; unknown when not assessed). Unit, source, population, cadence, owner, baseline, target and evidence_ids are instrumentation and validation that may still be pending; evidence_ids cites the evidence that the metric measures what it claims, and source names the evidence behind the baseline.

journey_or_node_id.description: Node, journey, or (for business outcomes) lifecycle or domain the metric is attached to.
